line: Nine of Cups: Crowley's title, planetary attribution and place on the Tree, with his account of the card.

sections.title: What Crowley says the card is
sections.line: Title and ruler, as the chapter gives them (pdf 180, 207).

quotes.quote: The Nine of Cups is called Happiness.
The Ruler is Jupiter in Pisces.

sections.title: Its place on the Tree
sections.line: The Nines belong to Yesod (pdf 180). The quoted record for this card does not name Yesod again.

quotes.quote: These cards are attributed to Yesod.

sections.title: What the card figures
sections.line: His description of the culmination, not a divinatory reading.

quotes.quote: In this card is the pageant of the culmination and perfection of the original force of Water.
